    Prepositions of Place 2 checks

    Prepositions of Place

    A1 · core

    Use in, on, under, and next to to say where things are.

    in | on | under | next to

    It is on the second floor, next to the cinema.

    Why: Use next to for something close beside another thing.

    Transcript line

    Then you are in luck.

    Why: Use in for something inside another thing.

    Transcript line

    Yes, we have two white ones on the shelf.

    Why: Use on for something touching the top of another thing.

    Transcript line
